_README: Per-arm transmitted signature, built read-only from results/run-conditions.json, results/passes-manifest.json and the *.meta.json files (harvested on sapphire 2026-10-05 at commit 1d6f29db3). signatures: JSON-encoded {stage, model (model of record: per-item model_version, else pricing_used.model, else configuration.model), temperature_eff (temperature_effective if present), thinking, sys_hash (first 12 hex of system_instruction_hash), examples_sent (proposer: images:<fp>/<n> only when include_example_images is true or absent AND the list is non-empty, else none; verifier: text-labels:<n> when text_only_labels present, else images:<fp>/<n> for a non-empty examples list, per scripts/lib_verifier.py build_reference_items), tile_size} -> count of metas. <fp> is sha256 of the ordered (path,label) list, first 12 hex. evidence: per-request tokens (per_item_metadata), aggregate tokens (usage_stats total / requests), or config fields only. pim_input_*: per-request input tokens from per_item_metadata. flags: replicate-group-N marks arms whose transmitted signature, test set and tile grid match another execution (group 9 h8-v2 canonical vs h10 coldstart-pool_160 removed: 327 vs 160 tiles; proposer-verifier-384 proposer removed from group 7: 1-item stub meta on the validation manifest).
